<groan>
The two seem to be breathing...
Your life is forfeit should you wander long about the deep wood.
I daresay you still have much to learn before you might justly claim the title of adventurer. Count yourself lucky we Wood Wailers came when we did.

Is that...[@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000088,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000088,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]? But that would mean... Did you come across a treant!?
Saved by moogles? To even see a moogle in one's lifetime is rare enough, but to be [@1A(1)]saved[@1A(0)] by a [@1A(1)]pack[@1A(0)] of them? Not many can make such a boast.
Did you see the darkened skies? The streaking lights and the falling comets? I know not what to make of it all...
The two outsiders?

If they are outsiders, I imagine they have made for the Adventurers' Guild. But that is just my guess. The Carline Canopy, it's called. To reach it, you need only take this path. You should pay a visit yourself, if you've not yet been.
Welcome to Gridania. You have undergone much to come this far. Passing through the forest when the elementals are angered is no easy thing.
I will delay you no longer. You must be weary. I urge you to visit our Adventurers' Guild, the Carline Canopy. Perhaps you will find some respite there.
Save your japes, or it'll be our limbs they're fetching!
Hit them harder!
Ugh...

text_en: You say you heard a voice singing sweet somethings in your ear now, did you?
Well, I've heard nothing of the sort. Perhaps all this brine has started to pickle your brain.

Rhotano Sea's known for bein' rough with the men who tread on her back. Why, every trip, it seems we lose a few casks to her relentless wrigglin' and writhin'. But worry ye not; I won't be lettin' her make off with our best rum.
A barrel's bounty can't be borne away if it be in me belly!
These seemingly endless sea voyages can truly drain a man's soul of its vim and vigor. Might I offer you a drink to enliven your spirits?
You hear somethin'? 'Cause I hear somethin'. Somethin's goin' on up top. An' that somethin' ain't quite right...
I'd go up an' see myself, but I don't want my adventurin' days endin' before they start! Why don't you see what's afoot?

Pardon me, [@IF($E9(4),milady,sir)], but have you seen that filthy Qiqirn? The one that was shuffling about hither and thither, sniffing everyone's baggage. I have an inkling he might be off getting that oversized nose of his into trouble...
They say the seas around Limsa Lominsa are guarded over by a goddess called the Navigator. If her temper's as bad as this accursed storm, I'd say we're all doomed.
Hmph. From that blank look in your eyes, I would guess you are not too well-traveled. Best scuttle over to that corner you were cowering in and go back to sleep.
You speak to me as if I have something to say. Well, I don't, so begone.

You say you heard singing? Well, maybe it was ol' Llymlaen laughin' at us mortals seeking to trespass in her fair demesne. Or maybe it were them silky-voiced sirens the people back in Limsa are a-fearin'. <sigh> Guess some places just ain't meant for an honest man.
Unable to sleep, friend? How about a drink to calm your nerves?
I knew I should have taken an inn room... One more bell amongst this rabble, and the smell alone will do for me.
<sniff> It's heartening to know at least one of you practices proper hygiene.
Then it is set! Once we arrive in Limsa, we shall make our way to the Adventurers' Guild and find us a noble quest! (One that will make us rich, of course! Ahahahah!)
Hm? You say you'd like to join us? I don't know... You don't look like the adventuring type...

Have you decided what endeavors you will undertake once you've arrived in Limsa Lominsa? That is, unless you're on a sort of spiritual journey to become one with your inner self...in which case, I assume you won't be doing much of anything.
Remember, only you can give your life any meaning.
I heard Limsa Lominsa's a filthy cesspool overridden with pirates and pillagers, wenches and wastrels... Heh heh, sounds like my kind of town!

Ye say ye saw a powerful sorceress weavin' her magicks 'round the ship, and that it's her what saved us from the serpent's minions? I ain't believin' what I ain't seen with me own two eyes, and I ain't seen no magickal wench, nor no serpent's minions.
But that storm we had─[@1A(1)]that[@1A(0)] be true enough. 'Tweren't fer our fearless Cap'n Hob, we'd all be rottin' at th' bottom o' Rhotano's belly! Don't ye go forgettin' that now, eh?
We're sailors. A little wind or rain won't keep us from findin' our way to port. Bloodthirsty aurelias, on the other hand...well, those we could do without.
Did you see that light? I hope it wasn't what I thought it was...because if it was what I thought it was, we wouldn't be here. Ah, but here is where we are, and all is well, is it not? Heh heh!
Now, my companion, on the other hand...is not here, and that is definitely [@1A(1)]not[@1A(0)] good. Might you have seen her?

Hah hah! My arrival in Limsa Lominsa marks the beginning of a new legend! Call forth the bards, for my adventures will inspire epic tales that shall be sung in the halls of kings and queens across the realm. You, my good [@IF($E9(4),lady,lad)], are a witness to history!
Is there anyone more reliable than a man of the sea? Perhaps I should have stayed on the ship rather than disembarking into this den of wolves.
Last night...I believe we were witness to something well beyond our comprehension, and I believe it is best to leave it at that.

As a merchant, it is never wise to ponder over that which can not earn one a profit...such as that [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000001,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000001,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] you carry. A fine specimen, albeit a tad ripe.
Ah, and our adventure on the seas comes to a close, only to make way for a new one upon the shores of this quaint island.

Perhaps our paths will cross again...and if you are planning on a visit to the Adventurers' Guild, then perhaps they will cross sooner than we think. I hear the good Captain Hob is heading there himself.
